name: Black Peak
blurb: The highest summit around Rainy Pass: a long traverse past three alpine lakes and a loose scramble to a view across the whole North Cascades.
permit: Northwest Forest Pass at Rainy Pass. Lewis and Wing Lakes lie inside the North Cascades NP Service Complex, so camping there needs a park wilderness permit.

links.label: North Cascades NP wilderness trip planner

routes.name: South Ridge
routes.summary: The Maple Pass trail to Heather Pass, a long talus traverse past Lewis Lake to larch-ringed Wing Lake, then a loose gully and the south ridge to the top.
skills: Hours of off-trail travel on talus and boulders

line.source: Placed by hand on terrain data and published route descriptions; not surveyed

waypoints.name: Heather Pass
waypoints.note: Leave the Maple Pass trail on the short spur to a small meadow.

waypoints.name: Wing Lake
waypoints.note: Larch bench beside the lake with views of Lewis Lake below. Fragile: camp on rock or established sites.

sections.note: Maple Pass loop trail from Rainy Pass, then the short spur to Heather Pass.
Climbers path across two talus fields, losing a few hundred feet, to Lewis Lake.
Up past Lewis Lake on boulders and heather to Wing Lake.
Scree and snow up the basin above Wing Lake to the south ridge, then class 3 to the summit.

pois.name: Loose scree gully
pois.note: Steepens into loose scree above Wing Lake. Space out to avoid knocking rocks onto your partners.
